async def act(page):
    # Fill the textbox to select members to invite with 'Abishek' to trigger autocomplete
    invite_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Select members to invite")
    await invite_textbox.fill("Abishek")
    # Wait for the autocomplete dropdown to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Select the specific user option 'Abishek S @abisubramanya27' from the dropdown
    user_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="Abishek S @abisubramanya27")
    await user_option.click()
    # Wait briefly for the button to become enabled
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click the 'Add to project' button to invite Abishek as a guest
    add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add to project")
    await add_button.click()
